summary: Iter 170 (Phase 3A — Central Catalog L0-L3 Payout & Karma Config) — Backend: 9/9 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iter170_catalog_payout.py covering GET /catalog/payout/config shape, default fields, PUT /global persistence + validation (max>=min returns 400), PUT/DELETE /node/{id} + 404 for unknown id, GET /resolve/{node_id} with _provenance, POST /preview cash equation (100+900*(4/5)*(1500/3000)=460.0 verified) and karma equation (5*(1+5/5)=10 verified) and unknown usage_type 400. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, super@test.com / SuperPass2026!): /admin/catalog-payout loads with equation reference card + 'Global defaults' card fully prefilled (3/100/1000/10/5 and step values 5/8/10/15/20); editing Payment max to 800 and tapping payout-save-global triggered the 'Saved' alert and the value persisted after a full reload (verified 800 in input on rehydrated page). 'Add' (payout-add-node) opened the modal, life-area chip 'Physical, Mental & Emotional Health' selected, 'Mental Health' (cn_l1_sa_hlt_mental, L1) picked, payment_min=25 entered, payout-save-node closed modal, 'Saved · Node override saved.' alert shown, and the override row appeared in 'Per-node overrides' with L1 level badge + correct payout summary (₹25–800). Pencil (payout-edit-cn_l1_sa_hlt_mental) opened 'Edit override' modal with payment_min prefilled to 25. Trash (payout-delete-cn_l1_sa_hlt_mental) showed in-app 'Remove override?' confirm modal — tapping 'Remove' deleted the row (API count went 1→0, 'No overrides yet' empty state rendered). Tester ADDED testIDs (payout-edit-${node_id}, payout-delete-${node_id}) to the pencil/trash TouchableOpacity buttons since they previously had no test hooks. No critical bugs found in this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/catalog_payout.py — payment_min/max validation in _clean() correctly raises 400 when max<min and is reused for both global and node upserts. Good DRY.
core/payout_engine.py provides equations centrally; the FE only renders them as read-only reference text, so the FE/BE will never drift. Good.

Inheritance chain (L3→L2→L1→L0→global→default) is exposed via /resolve/{node_id} with _provenance — enables future UI to show 'inherited from' indicators. Currently the FE list shows only direct overrides which is fine for v1.

catalog-payout.tsx — single screen, 537 lines (within the 700-line guidance). Uses StyleSheet.create; all interactive elements have testIDs after this iteration's fix. Inputs sanitize via t.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '').
